name: Trigger Public File Sync
description: Manually trigger the Drive→GCS sync for the public file service. This is a lightweight 1-step process that just hits the sync-service /sync-all endpoint and verifies the sync completed. Use this when a user wants to sync files, NOT p-sync-health-check (which is a multi-step health check).

steps.title: Trigger sync and verify
steps.description:
Trigger the sync-service to synchronize the Google Drive /public folder to GCS.

1. POST to ${sync_service_url}/sync-all with an empty JSON body
2. The response will include syncedFiles, ignoredFiles, and deletedFiles arrays
3. Report what was synced
4. Verify the public URL is accessible by checking https://tachin-website.web.app/public/index.html returns HTTP 200

Use the web-fetch tool to make the POST request. Do NOT use curl or run_command.
steps.accept_criteria: Sync completed. List of synced files reported. Public URL verified accessible.
